newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Taiwan sees no problems on WTO membership.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sees no problems on WTO membership.

text.p: Taiwan had encountered no hitches in its quest for admission to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) after concluding agreements with 12 countries and finalising six others, a senior official said on Saturday.

"No major problems have been encountered. Everything is going smoothly and I hope through negotiations and exchange of views, each side can understand each other better, then the WTO negotiations could be concluded to the benefit of the parties involved," Finance Minister Paul Chiu told Reuters Financial Television.

Asked about the possibility of Taiwan's membership in the WTO if China is admitted, Chiu said: "We always say that these are entirely different matters. The WTO has not set up these kinds of rules as to which countries should be permitted first."
Negotiations among countries should dictate admittance to the world trade body, Chiu said.
